other_failure_modes.name: Test data leakage during categorical encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates the training and test sets to fit a LabelEncoder for categorical features. This leaks the categorical distribution of the test set into the preprocessing pipeline, making the model transductive and unable to handle completely unseen data in a true production setting.

summary: The agent provides a solid LightGBM solution with cross-validation and thoughtful feature engineering. However, it fails to explicitly clean the data, relies on a single evaluation metric, uses naive unweighted ensembling across CV folds, and leaks test data information by fitting the LabelEncoder on the combined train and test sets.
